<p class="note-meta">Statistical estimation</p>

### [Why optimize log likelihood?](writing/log-likelihood.qmd)

A likelihood product and its logarithm share a maximizer. The logarithm gives additive derivatives and stable numerical computation.

### [Why the residual variance estimator is unbiased](writing/mse-unbiased.qmd)
